48559.commentary: (NIDD2) buddhaseṭṭhaṃ upāgamun'ti. buddho'ti yo so bhagavā… sacchikā paññatti, yadidaṃ buddho'ti. seṭṭhan'ti aggaṃ seṭṭhaṃ viseṭṭhaṃ pāmokkhaṃ uttamaṃ pavaraṃ buddhaṃ upāgamuṃ upāgamiṃsu upasaṅkamiṃsu payirupāsiṃsu paripucchiṃsu paripañhiṃsū'ti, buddhaseṭṭhaṃ upāgamuṃ.

āraddhavīriye pahit'atte, niccaṃ daḷhaparakkame, samagge sāvake passa, etaṃ buddhāna'vandanaṃ.
